Wiederholbare Einträge wie Waffen, Zaube: Repeatable entries such as weapons, spells, languages or attacks. Every entry has the same fields, for example name and damage.
Noch keine Liste. Leg oben eine an, zum: No list yet. Add one above, for example Weapons.
Steht in der Übersicht der Einträge vorn: Shown first in the overview of entries, for example the name.
Noch kein abgeleiteter Wert. Leg oben ei: No derived value yet. Add one above, for example a bonus.
Nur zur Zuordnung. Formeln rechnen immer: Only used for matching. Formulas always calculate with attributes, never with other derived values.
Was jeder Bogen erfüllen muss, zum Beisp: What every sheet must satisfy, for example: the spent points do not exceed the budget. If a rule is broken, its message appears when the sheet is saved.
Keine Bogenregeln. Jeder Bogen mit gülti: No sheet rules. Every sheet with valid attribute values can be saved.
Das liest, wer den Bogen speichern will,: This is what someone saving the sheet reads when the rule is broken.
Der Bogen ist leer. Lege im Reiter „Boge: The sheet is empty. Add at least one entry in the “Sheet” tab.
Der Bogen zeigt einen Eintrag, den es ni: The sheet shows an entry that no longer exists. Open the “Sheet” tab and take it off the sheet.
An entry appears twice on the sheet. Open the “Sheet” tab and take one of them off.
Ein Balken braucht ein Zahlenattribut fü: A bar needs a number attribute for its current value. Open the “Bars” tab and choose one.
Two bars use the same attribute. Each number attribute carries at most one bar.
Mit ungespeicherten Änderungen. Lade ihn: Has unsaved changes. Download it as a file or install it to keep it.
Jede installierte Version bleibt unverän: Every installed version stays unchangeable. A click opens it for viewing; editing means making a new version from it. The menu on an entry activates a version, takes it out of the library or brings it back.
Mit einer Vorlage, leer oder aus einer D: From a template, empty or from a file. Every template becomes a draft of your own that you can change freely.
So sieht der Bogen am Tisch aus: This is how the sheet looks at the table
Testfigur {name}. Werte lassen sich hier: Test character {name}. Try out values here; they belong to the preview only.
Die Vorschau erscheint, sobald der Entwu: The preview appears as soon as the draft has been valid once.
Die Testtafel zeigt zur Orientierung wei: For orientation, the test board keeps showing the last valid version ({version}) instead of disappearing while you edit. Your current draft is not valid yet: {fehler}
Noch keine Pakettests. Oben auf der Test: No package tests yet. On the test board above you can save an example for every character.
Abgeleitete Werte: Zahlen, die sich aus: Derived values: numbers that follow from attributes, for example a bonus. They are displayed, not stored.
Balken: Leben, Mana, Ausdauer und alles: Bars: life, mana, stamina and anything else that fills up and runs out during play.
Listen: wiederholbare Einträge wie Waffe: Lists: repeatable entries such as weapons, spells or languages.
Bogen: wie alles auf dem Charakterbogen: Sheet: how everything is arranged on the character sheet, with a preview.
Bogenregeln: was ein gültiger Bogen erfü: Sheet rules: what a valid sheet must satisfy before it is saved.
Ausprobieren: mit Testfiguren würfeln un: Try it out: roll with test characters and keep examples as package tests.
Übernehmen: diese Version installieren,: Adopt: install this version, check what changes for existing characters, and activate it for the round.
Im Reiter Bogenregeln öffnen: Open in the Sheet rules tab
Im Reiter Abgeleitete Werte öffnen: Open in the Derived values tab
Eine Bedingung ohne Würfel, zum Beispiel: A condition without dice, for example @stufe >= 2. Empty means: always visible.
Dieses Paket verwendet noch den klassisc: This package still uses the classic sheet. The first change takes over its section structure without loss and switches the package to the extended format.
So steht alles auf dem Charakterbogen, v: This is how everything appears on the character sheet, from top to bottom. Categories can be nested freely.
Auflösen nimmt nur die Kategorie weg; ih: Dissolving removes only the category; its contents move into its place.
Empty means: the name from the rulebook.
Choose an entry on the left.
Leben, Mana, Ausdauer: eine Zahl auf dem: Life, mana, stamina: a number on the sheet, a maximum and the question of what an empty bar means. One click creates the attribute and the bar together.
Noch kein Balken. Leg oben einen an, zum: No bar yet. Add one above, for example Life.

The number that rises and falls during play. Each number attribute carries at most one bar.
Der volle Balken, eine Zahl oder eine Re: The full bar: a number or a calculation such as @konstitution * 5.
Wähle links einen Balken oder leg einen: Choose a bar on the left or add one.
So sieht es am Tisch aus: This is how it looks at the table
Testfigur {name}. Die Werte gehören nur: Test character {name}. The values belong to the preview only and also appear on the test board.
Noch keine Balken, die sich rechnen lass: No bars that can be calculated yet.
